description: ITF.21 芸専 留学生 | イラストレーターのたまご | RU•ENG•日本語猛勉強中 | FFXIV、メカアニメ 、ゲーム全般 |  side acc: @kyogaming_

works.body:
Hello, kyo! I've been a fan of your art for a long time, so I'm pretty excited to see that you're using skeb!

I was wondering if you would draw my OC Yomiko. She's a foxgirl with green eyes, black hair & fur (sometimes with red or purple highlights), and either one or four tails. Her favorite colors are red and gold, and she likes accessories like flowers and earrings. She usually has a mysterious or playful attitude. She can also appear as either a human with fox ears and a tail, or as a full furry/kemono character.

I'll include a link to some reference images, but feel free to use your imagination and draw her however you like, I like being surprised! Thank you!

https://imgur.com/a/yomiko-Aw0b8NN

Hello! Your art is really good! I was wondering if you would be willing to draw my ghost girl character. 
ー
◦While she lived, she was a woman who reached the depths of spatial and temporal magics with her studies. However, her studies led her to knowledge no one should know. As a result, she lost her life. Her spirit was eventually resurrected by a druid, though her memory of her life was fractured. She now usually spends her days holed up in her manor's library, but occasionally ventures out.
◦Even as a spirit, she experiences any range of expressions, though typically mild.
◦Motifs associated with her are locked doors, keys, books, sunflowers, and the concept of time (clockwork, hourglasses, etc.). 
ー
If no instruction is okay, please compose it however you find most compelling. The setting is fantasy, but you're free to take whatever liberties you would like (I see FFXIV mentioned in your bio; similar sort of setting). Please use her formal outfit. Thank you for your consideration!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/17xWEFl-w9HKRJF62A4MiA3ICmoefju_g?usp=sharing

Your artwork is so lovely! I want to make a request for my oc if possible.  

Please draw him in this reference: https://toyhou.se/147894.ren-aspen   

Additional art: https://toyhou.se/147894.ren-aspen/5706489.art?key=ptuuYsvr3YfeWvn  

Ren: ♂ . 180 cm. Fluffy white hair and sapphire eyes. Has a beautiful appearance that appeals to both genders. A kind boy who is very sick, his heart is weak. His themes are blue roses, owls, books, and magic.  

Ren uses magic to grow blue roses. The petals from the roses are used to brew tea that heals people. Can you draw an illustration with that theme? Feel free to draw my oc in any kinds of poses. I leave the composition up to you.  

Thank you for considering and wish you a nice day!

Hi kyo, I found you through your latest skeb and fell in love with your art!
Could I request my VTuber character?

My character's main design is based on Chinese hanfu with black goldfish motifs.
Personality is calm, grounded and responsible, often taking care of others. Wistful/melancholic atmosphere.

Please choose whichever outfit you like! (There are a lot of alternate outfits in the other outfits folder)
Would be great to see whatever situation you think would fit the outfit!
If you need any ideas for what to draw:
- wisteria
- lantern festival (Chinese lanterns floating on water + into the sky)
- reflection in water

If possible, I'd prefer to have the character separated from the background, but it's also fine if it's not!

I'd like to use the illust on social media and possibly in a future cover and/or streams.

Thank you for the consideration!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/10rVTX7cY9urPa4hCLAtDR4tJ55PZnors?usp=sharing

Thank you for considering my request!

I stream TRPGs on Twitch and have followed your work forever! I'd love to get a picture for the end of the game of our party to show the audience with credit!

First Ridill: https://imgur.com/a/V2nvu4e
She's an ethereal sage! She's 5' 8''. She has a horn! She's kind and sad but hides by smiling! She loves her friends!

Ace: https://imgur.com/a/HYx93me
He's a martial artist and mech pilot! He is a tough, impulsive and unstable. He is 6' 2'' his mech: https://imgur.com/a/YuzdUKR

Willow: https://imgur.com/a/p7eKdRA
She is a short 5' 2'' brave hero! She a fist fighter and is optimistic and determined!

Arg0s: https://imgur.com/a/WKZ3Tmk
He is the cool tactician! He's 6' 4'' and is smart and calm

Basil: https://imgur.com/a/QPeoNGC
She's 5' 4'' and is very sweet! She has a dinosaur tail!

They are from a neon sci-fi city at the end of the world in a blizzard. The world is based in flame and frost!

Draw freely! Any setting or pose!

Thank you so much!

Hello! I love your art (especially your ff14 art!) and would love for you to draw my character! 

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Qco-mnFP4pAOWjyexnqezCa81CxpWmEn?usp=sharing

My character is a mermaid/dragon that lives underwater. Her people and home were destroyed a long time ago, but she still lives in its ruins, unable to let go of the past. She is elegant, thoughtful, sentimental and lonely.  Her major character arc has her look for revenge. Her important features are the three moles above her lip, the sparkle pupil in her eyes, her sharp eye shape, and the water pattern on the top of her head! She has fangs. Her major motifs are the moon/night sky and the tides.

Any pose and expression is okay! I would love a background if possible, but if the price is too low, feel free to send an offer with a different price. Thank you!
